units.id: mission:War Reactions: Syndicate Orphan|	"My brother is a private, third class, in the Syndicate's Ancillary Security Service." He grins proudly, clearly having practiced that delivery. "He monitors the Syndicate workplaces and he turned those boys in for smoking on the job last week. I guess they finally got a break for the repair shop and came after me since they can't hurt my brother."|222|0
units.english: "My brother is a private, third class, in the Syndicate's Ancillary Security Service." He grins proudly, clearly having practiced that delivery. "He monitors the Syndicate workplaces and he turned those boys in for smoking on the job last week. I guess they finally got a break for the repair shop and came after me since they can't hurt my brother."
units.italian: "Mio fratello è un soldato semplice di terza classe del Servizio di Sicurezza Ausiliario del Sindacato." Sorride con orgoglio: si vede che ha provato quella battuta. "Controlla i luoghi di lavoro del Sindacato e la settimana scorsa ha denunciato quei ragazzi perché fumavano durante il turno. Immagino che ora si siano presi una pausa dall'officina e siano venuti a cercare me, dato che non possono far male a mio fratello."

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Syndicate Orphan|	As you start walking, he answers. "No, I'm an orphan." He sees your confusion and explains. "The Syndicate lets some of us orphans work in industry. In return they give us better schooling, nicer housing, and doctor's visits." He puffs himself up. "Only the cleverest of us get to do it. All of the jobs for orphans are safe too; we don't use big dangerous equipment. Just ordinary stuff, like hammers, soldering irons, or sewing machines.|225|0
units.english: As you start walking, he answers. "No, I'm an orphan." He sees your confusion and explains. "The Syndicate lets some of us orphans work in industry. In return they give us better schooling, nicer housing, and doctor's visits." He puffs himself up. "Only the cleverest of us get to do it. All of the jobs for orphans are safe too; we don't use big dangerous equipment. Just ordinary stuff, like hammers, soldering irons, or sewing machines.
units.italian: Mentre cominci a camminare, risponde. "No, sono orfano." Vede che sei confuso e spiega. "Il Sindacato lascia che alcuni di noi orfani lavorino nell'industria. In cambio ci dà una scuola migliore, una casa più bella e le visite mediche." Si gonfia di orgoglio. "Solo i più svegli di noi possono farlo. E tutti i lavori per gli orfani sono sicuri: non usiamo macchinari grandi e pericolosi. Solo roba normale, come martelli, saldatori o macchine da cucire.

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Syndicate Orphan|	"Wait a minute!" He suddenly looks at you with wide eyes. "You're a captain, right? Were you in the big fights? I was on Maker when I saw some Pug ships fighting our ships on our school's big edu-screen."|226|0
units.english: "Wait a minute!" He suddenly looks at you with wide eyes. "You're a captain, right? Were you in the big fights? I was on Maker when I saw some Pug ships fighting our ships on our school's big edu-screen."
units.italian: "Aspetta un attimo!" All'improvviso ti guarda con gli occhi sgranati. "Sei un capitano, vero? Hai partecipato alle grandi battaglie? Ero su Maker quando ho visto delle navi Pug combattere contro le nostre sul grande schermo didattico della scuola."

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Syndicate Orphan|	"Yes, I'm Captain <first> <last>."|228|0
mission:War Reactions: Syndicate Orphan|	"I blew up my share of Pug ships."|230|0
units.english: "I blew up my share of Pug ships."
units.italian: "Ho fatto saltare la mia parte di navi Pug."

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Syndicate Orphan|	"Actually, I led the battle."|232|0
units.italian: "A dire il vero, ho guidato io la battaglia."

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Syndicate Orphan|	"Oh, hold on," he says, pulling out a durable-looking data pad labeled "Syndicate Childcare Device." After some typing and swiping, he declares, "You're Captain <first> <last>! Wow! It's an honor to meet you. Can I shake your hand?" He puts out his hand, and you shake it.|233|0
units.english: "Oh, hold on," he says, pulling out a durable-looking data pad labeled "Syndicate Childcare Device." After some typing and swiping, he declares, "You're Captain <first> <last>! Wow! It's an honor to meet you. Can I shake your hand?" He puts out his hand, and you shake it.
units.italian: "Oh, aspetta", dice, tirando fuori un tablet dall'aria robusta con l'etichetta "Dispositivo per l'Infanzia del Sindacato". Dopo aver digitato e sfogliato un po', dichiara: "Sei il capitano <first> <last>! Wow! È un onore conoscerti. Posso stringerti la mano?" Ti tende la mano e tu la stringi.

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Syndicate Orphan|	"Oh, hold on," he says, pulling out a durable-looking data pad labeled "Syndicate Childcare Device." After some typing and swiping, he declares, "You led the attack! Wow! It's an honor to meet you. Can I shake your hand?" He puts out his hand, and you shake it.|236|0
units.english: "Oh, hold on," he says, pulling out a durable-looking data pad labeled "Syndicate Childcare Device." After some typing and swiping, he declares, "You led the attack! Wow! It's an honor to meet you. Can I shake your hand?" He puts out his hand, and you shake it.
units.italian: "Oh, aspetta", dice, tirando fuori un tablet dall'aria robusta con l'etichetta "Dispositivo per l'Infanzia del Sindacato". Dopo aver digitato e sfogliato un po', dichiara: "Hai guidato tu l'attacco! Wow! È un onore conoscerti. Posso stringerti la mano?" Ti tende la mano e tu la stringi.

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Syndicate Orphan|	"I bet you did! I wish I was on one of our warships, bravely defending us all. Blowing up Pugs, getting paid. It sounds amazing!"|239|0
units.english: "I bet you did! I wish I was on one of our warships, bravely defending us all. Blowing up Pugs, getting paid. It sounds amazing!"
units.italian: "Ci scommetto! Vorrei essere su una delle nostre navi da guerra, a difenderci tutti con coraggio. Far saltare i Pug, prendere lo stipendio. Dev'essere fantastico!"

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Syndicate Orphan|	"What was it like, fighting those nasty, evil Pugs?"|241|0
units.english: "What was it like, fighting those nasty, evil Pugs?"
units.italian: "Com'era combattere quei Pug cattivi e malvagi?"

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Syndicate Orphan|	"War is hell, kid. I'm not going to glorify it for you."|243|0
units.english: "War is hell, kid. I'm not going to glorify it for you."
units.italian: "La guerra è un inferno, ragazzo. Non ho intenzione di abbellirtela."

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Syndicate Orphan|	"Actually, they're not evil. Their 'war' was a ploy to get us to stop fighting among ourselves. A lot of Pug gave their lives willingly to save us from self-destruction."|245|0
units.english: "Actually, they're not evil. Their 'war' was a ploy to get us to stop fighting among ourselves. A lot of Pug gave their lives willingly to save us from self-destruction."
units.italian: "A dire il vero, non sono malvagi. La loro 'guerra' era un trucco per farci smettere di combattere tra noi. Molti Pug hanno dato la vita di buon grado per salvarci dall'autodistruzione."

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Syndicate Orphan|	"Leading a battle is like chess with guns and engines. It's the most exhilarating feeling I've ever felt."|246|0
units.english: "Leading a battle is like chess with guns and engines. It's the most exhilarating feeling I've ever felt."
units.italian: "Guidare una battaglia è come giocare a scacchi con cannoni e motori. È la sensazione più esaltante che abbia mai provato."

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Syndicate Orphan|	"It was an honor to protect the human race from our attackers."|248|0
units.english: "It was an honor to protect the human race from our attackers."
units.italian: "È stato un onore proteggere la razza umana dai nostri aggressori."

units.id: mission:War Reactions: Syndicate Orphan|	"Woah, you sound really smart. Like one of those sensible experts in the vids! Still, without people like you, the Pug's plan couldn't have worked. I still reckon you were the best, Captain."|250|0
units.english: "Woah, you sound really smart. Like one of those sensible experts in the vids! Still, without people like you, the Pug's plan couldn't have worked. I still reckon you were the best, Captain."
units.italian: "Uau, parli proprio da intelligente. Come uno di quegli esperti assennati dei video! Però, senza gente come te, il piano dei Pug non avrebbe potuto funzionare. Resta il fatto che sei stato il migliore, capitano."
